response.justification: Bogdan brings genuine staff-level breadth, including standout high-throughput distributed systems work (millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic) and current hands-on experience building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, which aligns well with the role's agentic-development mindset. However, the resume shows no evidence of Python, a must-have skill for this role, and lacks explicit signals of stakeholder management, on-call/incident ownership, or formal agile practice, which are all core requirements.
strengths: Deep high-throughput distributed systems experience (micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests/sec)
Currently building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP-based developer tooling, directly matching the AI-native engineering context
Broad staff-level career across many stacks and domains, indicating strong systems thinking and adaptability
concerns: No demonstrated Python experience despite it being an explicit must-have skill
Little explicit evidence of cross-functional stakeholder management with product/leadership
No clear mention of on-call/incident response ownership or structured agile/scrum ceremony experience
